answer_1.quote: Composing a meta-review from peer reviewers' comments includes the following steps: 1. Collect expert opinions... 2. Analyze the comments... 3. Present meta-reviewer's own judgment...

answer_2.quote: Although there are several popular text generation evaluation metrics such as ROUGE, SEM-F1, we exclusively focus on meticulous qualitative human evaluation...

answer_3.quote: we also conducted a GPT-4-based evaluation of MPSs... prompted the GPT-4o model to asses the five aspects of MPSs using the Likert scale...

answer_4.quote: we performed an extensive qualitative analysis by engaging human evaluators... collected comprehensive survey data, which includes 4800 granular manuscript level judgments...
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators judged generated MPSs on five criteria using assertive statements rated via a 5-point agreement scale (Strongly Agree to Strongly Disagree).
